description: Implement the Dashboard page (the most visually rich page) with Leaflet live map, Recharts revenue + trips-per-vehicle charts, stat cards, and recent alerts. Also wire the StatCard component to accept ReactNode icons (matching driver-dashboard's pattern). Depends on FEAT-001 (StatCard stub exists, api.ts ready) and FEAT-002 (AlertBadge component exists). This feature also does final cleanup: fix any residual TypeScript errors, verify Leaflet icon defaults are patched, confirm the full build is green.
steps: Step 1 — Update src/components/StatCard.tsx from its stub to the full implementation. Copy the StatCard from apps/driver-dashboard/src/components/StatCard.tsx exactly: props {title, value, icon: React.ReactNode, color:'blue'|'green'|'yellow'|'purple'|'red', trend?: string, subtext?: string}. colorClasses map. White rounded-lg shadow card. This component is used by Dashboard and Drivers pages.

Step 2 — Implement src/pages/Dashboard.tsx. This is the most complex page. Structure: (a) Page header 'Fleet Overview' with live timestamp. (b) 4 StatCards: total vehicles (mock count from vehicles), online drivers (GET /api/v1/tracking/nearby?lat=-6.7924&lng=39.2083&radius=50 — count returned drivers; mock if 0), active trips (GET /api/v1/trips with status=in_progress; mock count), today revenue (GET /api/v1/earnings/summary — use today field; mock if fails). (c) Leaflet map section (h-80, rounded-lg overflow-hidden) showing fleet vehicles — GET /api/v1/tracking/nearby for live positions; fall back to mock markers (// MOCK DATA: 3 mock drivers near Dar es Salaam: lat ~-6.79, lng ~39.21). MapContainer center={[-6.7924, 39.2083]} zoom=12 with TileLayer from OSM ('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png'). Each driver is a Marker with Popup showing driverId. Fix Leaflet default icon BEFORE rendering: import L from 'leaflet'; import markerIcon2x from 'leaflet/dist/images/marker-icon-2x.png'; import markerIcon from 'leaflet/dist/images/marker-icon.png'; import markerShadow from 'leaflet/dist/images/marker-shadow.png'; delete (L.Icon.Default.prototype as any)._getIconUrl; L.Icon.Default.mergeOptions({ iconUrl: markerIcon, iconRetinaUrl: markerIcon2x, shadowUrl: markerShadow }); — put this in a module-level block above the component. (d) Revenue line chart: GET /api/v1/earnings/history — aggregate by day for last 7 days; mock array of 7 {day, revenue} if API fails. Use Recharts LineChart, ResponsiveContainer, CartesianGrid, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, Line. stroke='#3b82f6'. (e) Trips-per-vehicle bar chart: mock data (// MOCK DATA) [{plate:'T123ABC', trips:12}, ...] for 5 vehicles. BarChart with fill='#10b981'. (f) Recent alerts section: static mock list (// MOCK DATA) of 5 alerts: [{type:'maintenance', message:'Vehicle T123ABC due for service', time:'2h ago'}, {type:'offline', message:'Driver Juma went offline unexpectedly', time:'4h ago'}, ...]. Use AlertBadge for type coloring. All labels use t(). Loading spinner (animate-spin border-blue-600) while data fetches.

Step 3 — Fix Leaflet TypeScript: ensure @types/leaflet is in devDependencies (already added in FEAT-001 step 1). Verify vite.config.ts does not need special handling for leaflet image imports — Vite handles PNG imports natively when imported as modules. If TypeScript complains about PNG imports, add 'declare module "*.png" { const src: string; export default src; }' to src/vite-env.d.ts.

Step 4 — Final TypeScript audit: open each file and fix any remaining TS errors. Common issues: (a) useTranslation() return — destructure as const { t } = useTranslation(); (b) chart data arrays need explicit types or 'as const' casting; (c) Leaflet map types — MapContainer props are typed by react-leaflet, ensure react-leaflet is in dependencies (add 'react-leaflet@^4.2.1' if not already there from FEAT-001). (d) i18n JSON imports — tsconfig has 'resolveJsonModule: true' in tsconfig.base.json — confirm operator-dashboard tsconfig.json inherits it and adds 'resolveJsonModule: true' to its own compilerOptions if not inherited.

Step 5 — Verify the complete file tree matches requirements. Confirm all 28 files exist: index.html, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/vite-env.d.ts, src/index.css, src/components/Sidebar.tsx, src/components/StatCard.tsx, src/components/VehicleCard.tsx, src/components/DriverCard.tsx, src/components/AlertBadge.tsx, src/pages/Login.tsx, src/pages/Dashboard.tsx, src/pages/Fleet.tsx, src/pages/Drivers.tsx, src/pages/Earnings.tsx, src/pages/Reports.tsx, src/pages/Settings.tsx, src/services/api.ts, src/store/auth.ts, src/i18n/index.ts, src/i18n/en.json, src/i18n/sw.json, src/components/RequireAuth.tsx (or inline in App.tsx). Missing files should be created now.

Step 6 — Run npm run build. Fix any remaining errors. Common expected issues at this stage: (1) recharts types for ResponsiveContainer children — wrap in a function if needed; (2) lucide-react icon size prop — pass size={20} as number not string; (3) leaflet CSS import ordering — ensure @import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css' is the FIRST line in index.css before @tailwind directives.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with zero TypeScript errors and zero Vite build errors
Dashboard.tsx renders 4 StatCards, a Leaflet map, a revenue LineChart, a trips BarChart, and a recent alerts list
StatCard.tsx accepts icon as ReactNode, has 5 color variants
Leaflet default icon is patched (no broken image tiles on markers)
All 25+ files listed in requirements exist in the correct paths
